verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own ongoing-monitoring capability for continuously reviewing customer risk. It also offers registrable webhooks and alert/case workflows for acting on screening hits. However, the evidence never explicitly ties watchlist updates to automatic re-screening of existing customers, nor to events fired on those changes; the only documented webhook type is WORKFLOW_COMPLETED for screening workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that monitored customers are re-screened when watchlists update, a monitoring-specific event or webhook type for new or changed hits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
